answer: Proof-of-Space-Time curbs Sybil attacks by tying each agent identity to committed disk capacity. Nodes seal unique, incompressible onyx plots over an audit horizon and answer rapid Merkle challenges, so one host cannot harbor phantom clones by recomputing data on demand. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating physical storage and disk IOPS per identity. However, fast NVMe arrays or custom ASICs can exploit time-memory trade-offs to regenerate sectors dynamically.
